newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares slump 6.85 pct on govt concerns.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares slump 6.85 pct on govt concerns.

text.p: The Istanbul stock market index fell sharply on Thursday morning amid concerns about the future of Turkey's Islamist-led coalition government following a 6-1/2 day holiday, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 ended at 1,427, down 105 points, or 6.85 percent from the April 17 midday close of 1,532. It brushed a low of 1,420 in the session. Morning volume firmed 6.78 trillion lira from 5.66 trillion on April 17.

"The dominant view (in the market) is that the government will fall. I think the market will be relieved if the government collapses. The index may fall to 1,350 levels by the weekend," said Korhan Biricik from Deha securities.

Of the 248 shares traded, falls outdid rises sharpy by 237 to six and five finished steady. The IMKB Industrial dived 6.54 percent to 1,429, the IMKB Services lost 5.73 percent to 1,350 and the IMKB Financial plunged 7.61 percent to 1,529.
